all-omitted.error: There are no checked suggestions to export. Unavailable days stay open.

invalid-date.error: Choose a valid calendar date for your week.

extra-assignment.error: The saved arrangement must include every original pick exactly once.

missing-calendar-id.error: The saved week has an invalid calendar identity.

mismatched-constraints.error: The saved inputs and the original response have different constraints.

control-in-omitted-pick.error: The plan contains unsupported characters in explanation. Generate a new plan before exporting.

surrogate-in-source.error: The plan contains unsupported characters in venue name. Generate a new plan before exporting.

duplicate-original-slot.error: The plan repeats a day and type. Generate a new plan before exporting.

empty-plan.error: There are no checked suggestions to export. Unavailable days stay open.
